310 static auto GetGamepad(int32 Index = 0) -> FGamepadState {
311 FGamepadState State;
312 State.bConnected = SlamGamepadNumber(Index, 0, 0) != 0;
313 if (!State.bConnected)
314 return State;
315 for (int Item = 0; Item < 8; ++Item)
316 State.Axes.push_back(static_cast<float>(SlamGamepadNumber(Index, 1, Item)));
317 for (int Item = 0; Item < 20; ++Item)
318 State.Buttons.push_back(static_cast<float>(SlamGamepadNumber(Index, 2, Item)));
319 return State;
320 }

591inline auto SplitArguments(std::string_view Payload) -> TResult<TArray<FString>> {
592 TArray<FString> Values;
593 std::size_t Cursor = 0;
594 while (Cursor < Payload.size()) {
595 const auto Colon = Payload.find(':', Cursor);
596 if (Colon == std::string_view::npos)
597 return TResult<TArray<FString>>::Error(EPlatformError::InvalidArgument,
598 "Invalid argument payload.");
599 std::size_t Length = 0;
600 try {
601 Length = static_cast<std::size_t>(
602 std::stoull(FString(Payload.substr(Cursor, Colon - Cursor))));
603 } catch (...) {
604 return TResult<TArray<FString>>::Error(EPlatformError::InvalidArgument,
605 "Invalid argument length.");
606 }
607 Cursor = Colon + 1;
608 if (Length > Payload.size() - Cursor)
609 return TResult<TArray<FString>>::Error(EPlatformError::InvalidArgument,
610 "Truncated argument payload.");
611 Values.emplace_back(Payload.substr(Cursor, Length));
612 Cursor += Length;
613 }
614 return TResult<TArray<FString>>::Ok(std::move(Values));
615}

617template <typename T> auto Convert(const FString &Value) -> TResult<T> {
618 try {
619 if constexpr (std::is_same_v<T, FString>)
620 return TResult<T>::Ok(Value);
621 else if constexpr (std::is_same_v<T, bool>) {
622 if (Value == "true" || Value == "1" || Value == "yes" || Value == "on")
623 return TResult<T>::Ok(true);
624 if (Value == "false" || Value == "0" || Value == "no" || Value == "off" ||
625 Value.empty())
626 return TResult<T>::Ok(false);
627 } else if constexpr (std::is_integral_v<T>) {
628 std::size_t Used = 0;
629 const auto Parsed = std::stoll(Value, &Used);
630 if (Used == Value.size() && Parsed >= std::numeric_limits<T>::min() &&
631 Parsed <= std::numeric_limits<T>::max())
632 return TResult<T>::Ok(static_cast<T>(Parsed));
633 } else if constexpr (std::is_floating_point_v<T>) {
634 std::size_t Used = 0;
635 const auto Parsed = std::stod(Value, &Used);
636 if (Used == Value.size())
637 return TResult<T>::Ok(static_cast<T>(Parsed));
638 }
639 } catch (...) {
640 }
641 return TResult<T>::Error(EPlatformError::InvalidArgument,
642 "Could not convert argument value.");
643}
644
645template <typename T> auto Stringify(const T &Value) -> FString {
646 if constexpr (std::is_same_v<T, FString>)
647 return Value;
648 else if constexpr (std::is_same_v<T, bool>)
649 return Value ? "true" : "false";
650 else {
651 std::ostringstream Out;
652 Out << Value;
653 return Out.str();
654 }
655}
656
657struct IBinding {
658 virtual ~IBinding() = default;
659 virtual auto Invoke(const TArray<FString> &) -> TResult<FString> = 0;
660};
661inline auto Bindings() -> std::unordered_map<FName, std::unique_ptr<IBinding>> & {
662 static std::unordered_map<FName, std::unique_ptr<IBinding>> Value;
663 return Value;
664}
665
666template <typename> struct TFunctionBinding;
667template <typename Return, typename... Args>
668struct TFunctionBinding<Return (*)(Args...)> final : IBinding {
669 using FPointer = Return (*)(Args...);
670 explicit TFunctionBinding(FPointer InFunction) : Function(InFunction) {}
671 auto Invoke(const TArray<FString> &Values) -> TResult<FString> override {
672 if (Values.size() != sizeof...(Args))
673 return TResult<FString>::Error(EPlatformError::InvalidArgument,
674 "Function argument count does not match.");
675 return InvokeAt(Values, std::index_sequence_for<Args...>{});
676 }
677 template <std::size_t... I>
678 auto InvokeAt(const TArray<FString> &Values, std::index_sequence<I...>)
679 -> TResult<FString> {
680 auto Converted = std::tuple<TResult<std::decay_t<Args>>...>(
681 Convert<std::decay_t<Args>>(Values[I])...);
682 bool Valid = (std::get<I>(Converted).IsOk() && ...);
683 if (!Valid)
684 return TResult<FString>::Error(EPlatformError::InvalidArgument,
685 "One or more arguments could not be converted.");
686 if constexpr (std::is_void_v<Return>) {
687 Function(std::get<I>(Converted).GetValue()...);
688 return TResult<FString>::Ok({});
689 } else
690 return TResult<FString>::Ok(
691 Stringify(Function(std::get<I>(Converted).GetValue()...)));
692 }
693 FPointer Function;
694};
695
696template <typename Pointer> struct TBindingRegistration {
697 TBindingRegistration(const char *Name, Pointer Function) {
698 Bindings()[Name] = std::make_unique<TFunctionBinding<Pointer>>(Function);
699 }
700};

702using FApplicationFactory = std::unique_ptr<FApplication> (*)();
703inline auto ApplicationFactory() -> FApplicationFactory & {
704 static FApplicationFactory Value = nullptr;
705 return Value;
706}
707inline auto Application() -> std::unique_ptr<FApplication> & {
708 static std::unique_ptr<FApplication> Value;
709 return Value;
710}
711template <typename T> struct TApplicationRegistration {
712 TApplicationRegistration() {
713 ApplicationFactory() = []() -> std::unique_ptr<FApplication> {
714 return std::make_unique<T>();
715 };
716 }
717};

719inline auto HttpCallbacks()
720 -> std::unordered_map<uint32, TDelegate<void(TResult<FHttpResponse>)>> & {
721 static std::unordered_map<uint32, TDelegate<void(TResult<FHttpResponse>)>> Value;
722 return Value;
723}
724inline uint32 NextRequest = 1;
725
726} // namespace Private

728class FHttpClient {
729public:
731 static auto Get(std::string_view Url,
732 TDelegate<void(TResult<FHttpResponse>)> Callback) -> FRequestHandle {
733 const auto Handle = Private::NextRequest++;
734 Private::HttpCallbacks()[Handle] = std::move(Callback);
735 const FString Value(Url);
736 SlamHttpGet(static_cast<int>(Handle), Value.c_str());
737 return {Handle};
738 }
739
740 static auto Cancel(FRequestHandle Handle) -> bool {
741 return Private::HttpCallbacks().erase(Handle.Id) != 0;
742 }
743};
744class FAssetManager {
745public:
747 static auto LoadText(std::string_view Url, TDelegate<void(TResult<FString>)> Callback)
748 -> FRequestHandle {
749 return FHttpClient::Get(Url, [Callback = std::move(Callback)](
750 TResult<FHttpResponse> Response) mutable {
751 if (Response)
752 Callback(TResult<FString>::Ok(Response.GetValue().Body));
753 else
754 Callback(TResult<FString>::Error(Response.GetError(), Response.GetMessage()));
755 });
756 }
757};
758
759extern "C" EMSCRIPTEN_KEEPALIVE inline void
760slam_http_complete(int Handle, int Status, const char *Body, const char *Error) {
761 const auto Found = Private::HttpCallbacks().find(static_cast<uint32>(Handle));
762 if (Found == Private::HttpCallbacks().end())
763 return;
764 auto Callback = std::move(Found->second);
765 Private::HttpCallbacks().erase(Found);
766 if (Error && *Error)
767 Callback(TResult<FHttpResponse>::Error(EPlatformError::Network, Error));
768 else
769 Callback(TResult<FHttpResponse>::Ok({Status, Body ? Body : ""}));
770}
771
772extern "C" EMSCRIPTEN_KEEPALIVE inline auto slam_invoke(const char *Name,
773 const char *Payload) -> const
774 char * {
775 const auto Found = Private::Bindings().find(Name ? Name : "");
776 if (Found == Private::Bindings().end()) {
777 Private::BridgeResult = "1:Function is not registered.";
778 return Private::BridgeResult.c_str();
779 }
780 const auto Values = Private::SplitArguments(Payload ? Payload : "");
781 if (!Values) {
782 Private::BridgeResult = "1:" + Values.GetMessage();
783 return Private::BridgeResult.c_str();
784 }
785 const auto Result = Found->second->Invoke(Values.GetValue());
786 Private::BridgeResult =
787 Result ? "0:" + Result.GetValue() : "1:" + Result.GetMessage();
788 return Private::BridgeResult.c_str();
789}
790extern "C" EMSCRIPTEN_KEEPALIVE inline void slam_start_application() {
791 if (auto Factory = Private::ApplicationFactory()) {
792 Private::Application() = Factory();
793 Private::Application()->BeginPlay();
794 }
795}
796extern "C" EMSCRIPTEN_KEEPALIVE inline void slam_tick(float DeltaTime) {
797 if (Private::Application())
798 Private::Application()->Tick(DeltaTime);
799}
800extern "C" EMSCRIPTEN_KEEPALIVE inline void slam_stop_application() {
801 if (Private::Application()) {
802 Private::Application()->EndPlay();
803 Private::Application().reset();
804 }
805}
806extern "C" EMSCRIPTEN_KEEPALIVE inline void slam_suspend_application(int Suspended) {
807 if (Private::Application()) {
808 if (Suspended)
809 Private::Application()->OnSuspend();
810 else
811 Private::Application()->OnResume();
812 }
813}
814extern "C" EMSCRIPTEN_KEEPALIVE inline void slam_resize_application() {
815 if (Private::Application())
816 Private::Application()->OnResize(FCanvas::GetSize());
817}
